text: The tables above are CLI measures and `opcache.enable_cli=0`, so they are **compile** cost, exactly the trap 4n documents. In the production configuration the app's own instrumentation puts the **entire** helper load — all 348 files, 5039 KB — at **7.65 ms**. `cms` + `ecommerce` are 43% of the bytes, so about **3.3 ms** of it.
